name: Procter & Gamble Co.
summary:
Procter & Gamble (PG) reported earnings of $1.43 per share on revenue of $21.20 billion for the fiscal fourth quarter ended June 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $1.41 per share on revenue of $21.40 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $1.44 per share. The company missed expectations by 0.69% while revenue grew 1.50% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it expects fiscal 2027 earnings of $6.89 to $7.10 per share. The current consensus earnings estimate is $7.03 per share for the year ending June 30, 2027.

Procter & Gamble Co provides branded consumer packaged goods. It markets its products in about 180 countries through mass merchandisers, grocery stores, membership club stores, drug stores, department stores among others.
subject: Procter & Gamble Missed Expectations
